passes: Whole-catalogue forward candidate ranking over prompt+key and full-card text; inspect candidate prompts, keyed answers, and factual proposition for each target.

method.limitations: Lexical similarity is a candidate generator, not a semantic proof. This addendum records examined likely candidates surfaced in the available run; it does not claim every low-scoring lexical pair was manually read.
